LanguageData.ABY_CraftGatebreakerCarapace.label: forge gatebreaker carapace
LanguageData.ABY_CraftGatebreakerCarapace.description: Rebuild a saint-grade core shell into a black abyssal assault carapace meant for the next gate, not the last battle. This pattern sacrifices reactor remnant geometry for heavier anti-breach plating and a more openly hostile battlefield profile.
LanguageData.ABY_CraftGatebreakerHelm.label: forge gatebreaker helm
LanguageData.ABY_CraftGatebreakerHelm.description: Condense saint-class field hardware and black plasteel into a sealed predatory gate helm. The result is less ceremonial than crowned gear and more direct: an execution visor for controlled breaches that are expected to fight back.
